`final class SnapshotBridgeRestorer`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [SnapshotBridgeRestorer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/SnapshotBridgeRestorer.java)

Remembers the bridges of every registry and later unregisters every bridge registered since.

## Description

A snapshot backend creates one before it registers, and calls `restore()` in `destroy()`, so that the next suite starts clean.

- [Give the testkit a surface](/build/testing-a-backend/#give-the-testkit-a-surface)
